title: 2012 AMC 10B Problem 3
statement: The point in the \(xy\)-plane with coordinates \((1000, 2012)\) is reflected across the line \(y=2000.\) What are the coordinates of the reflected point?

solutions.text:
Notice that the line in question is perfectly horizontal. This means that if we were to construct a perpendicular line segment from the point to the line, to find the reflected coordinates of the point, we simply double the distance along that line segment.

The line segment from \((1000,2012)\) to \(y=2000\) is of length \(12,\) so the reflected point is along this same line segment, but a distance of \(12\) on the other side of the horizontal line. This yields \((1000,1988).\)

Thus, the correct answer is B .
